description: statusCheckNames.minimumReleaseAge disables the stability commit status
Renovate would otherwise POST to repos/:owner/:repo/statuses/:sha for every
branch held by minimumReleaseAge. The dk-renovate-bot App token is scoped
without `statuses`, so that POST returned 403 integration-unauthorized,
which Renovate surfaces as REPOSITORY_CHANGED and then abandons the whole
repository -- while still exiting 0. That silently broke every run from
2026-07-21 on, leaving pushed renovate/* branches whose PRs were never
opened. Nulling the status check name is how the sibling repos
this, and it is the least-privilege fix: it drops a cosmetic status check
rather than granting the token a new write scope. minimumReleaseAge itself
still applies -- Renovate holds the update internally; only the commit
